items.problem: The scaffold namespace Package shadowed Windows.ApplicationModel.Package, producing CS0234 in all three scenario files.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3106-3108; turns 27-29 fixed each use with an AppPackage alias.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Common build errors > CS0104 ambiguity, final paragraph about fully qualifying colliding type names
items.proposed_improvement: Extend the existing name-collision guidance with the namespace-shadows-WinRT-type CS0234 form and a type-alias example.
items.generalizes: Samples and projects are often named for the API they demonstrate, so names such as Package can shadow imported WinRT types after scaffolding.

items.problem: The migrated shell added a Settings destination, custom title bar, backdrop/icon chrome, and changed pane/content proportions absent from the UWP source.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json Application shell layout-difference; migrated MainWindow.xaml contains TitleBar and MicaBackdrop, and MainPage NavigationView leaves IsSettingsVisible at its default.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md > Principles, Shell conversion, Navigation invariants, and Critical Rules > Fidelity
items.proposed_improvement: Make shell invariants explicitly prohibit synthetic destinations and scaffold-only visual chrome, name IsSettingsVisible=False when no source settings page exists, and require preserving source proportions.
items.generalizes: WinUI scaffolds and NavigationView defaults routinely add UI that was not present in a migrated UWP shell.
